cover_letter.greeting: Dear Data & Analytics Strategic Execution Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Associate role on the Strategic Execution & Business Operations Team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What stands out to me is that this team is the chief-of-staff function for a 2,000-person organization, so the work is about helping leaders turn priorities into coordinated action. I also like that the seat covers AI productivity measurement and executive reporting, not just meeting logistics.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked as a consultant on marketing-channel budget allocation. I turned large datasets into executive reporting and dashboards for senior leadership, and benchmarked past allocations in work that identified 30% in efficiency gains. At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst working across teams. I documented business requirements, turned stakeholder needs into dashboards, and owned the mapping and QA on reporting automation that saved 4+ hours a week.

That maps to the operating rhythms, business reviews and leadership materials here. I'm comfortable being the person who tracks the moving parts and gets a clear summary in front of leadership. Exposure to the firm from my JPMorgan work also helps me understand how a large matrixed organization runs. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and I'm applying for the Senior Associate role on the Strategic Execution & Business Operations Team. I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management as a consultant, building executive reporting and dashboards for senior leadership, and at Lenovo before that. I'd love to hear how the team runs its operating rhythms. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
